citation.title: Process-aware topology optimization leveraging deep learning surrogate model-based functions for laser powder bed fusion
citation.authors: Praveen S. Vulimiri; Shane Garner; Albert C. To
citation.version_coded: abstract only; publisher full text blocked

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract reports that its surrogate evaluates much faster than a single finite element process simulation; whether the article compares complete optimization runs with a classical TO method is unresolved.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Publisher highlights say over 100-fold faster surrogate evaluation than one process FEA; this is not a complete optimization speed-up.
claim.alternatives: Abstract compares 2.5 days for the largest optimized case with four days for one verification FEA, which is not a classical optimization run.

baseline.problem_size: hundreds of thousands of design variables (abstract)
baseline.classical_time: 4 days for one verification FEA, not an optimization run (abstract)
baseline.ml_time: 2.5 days for largest optimization with over 400 iterations (abstract)
baseline.quality_metric: residual distortion and end-use mechanical performance (abstract)

notes: DOI landing page redirects to ScienceDirect, which returned HTTP 403. The author's PDF link also points to ScienceDirect. Search found no legitimate repository full text. The abstract states zero build failures; publisher page states the underlying data are confidential.
